testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain an arithmetic expression in a model-state parameter ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user opens the model-state table and adds length parameter d0 to the table ✔ And The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing length parameter d0 ✔ And Copy State is active ✔ And the Primary and Capture State d0 values are 1 in ✔ When the user enters "1 in + 0.5 in" in the Copy State d0 cell ✔ And accepts and reopens the model-state table ✔ Then the Copy State d0 cell displays the entered arithmetic expression ✔ And the parameter tree displays the active member expression ✔ And the Primary and Capture State d0 cells still display 1 in ✔ When the user closes the table and opens Parameters ✔ Then d0 has nominal and model values of 1.5 in
